explanation: Matches the first question on erdosproblems.com/317: is there c > 0 such that for every n ≥ 1 some signs δ_k ∈ {-1,0,1} give 0 < |Σ δ_k/k| < c/2^n? The 0-indexed k + 1 denominators are cast before adding, as the proved counterexample lemma confirms, so there is no Fin wraparound. Correctly marked open.
